Fundraiser created for 3 Richmond family members killed in alleged arson fire

by Kiley Russell, Bay City News August 24, 2026August 23, 2026

Share this:

Instaread

A relative of three people killed in a suspected arson fire in Richmond on Tuesday is asking for help raising money for their funeral expenses.

Evelin Rivera’s 47-year-old father, 5-year-old nephew and 2-year-old niece were killed in a house fire allegedly started by her brother, 32-year-old Sergio Rivera-Vega.

Kiley Russell, Bay City News

Kiley Russell writes primarily for Local News Matters on issues related to equity and the environment. A Bay Area native, he has lived most of his life in Oakland. He studied journalism at San Francisco State University, worked for the Associated Press and the former Contra Costa Times, among other outlets. He has covered everything from state legislatures, local governments, federal and state courts, crime, growth and development, political campaigns of various stripes, wildfires and the aftermath of Hurricane Katrina.
